intent: Move through rain-washed archways, choosing low jumps or diagonal launches to fit the openings. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The first rain arch
sections.lesson: Small jumps fit beneath the rain arches. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The first rain arch
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: Spray beside the blossom
sections.lesson: Rise with the spray · leave through the side opening. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
Spray beside the blossom
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: Between the rainbow arches
sections.lesson: Launch diagonally between the arch crowns. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
Between the rainbow arches
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The blossom arcade
sections.lesson: The arch height changes the jump you need. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The blossom arcade
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The rainbow lookout
sections.lesson: Change direction around the garden’s high arches. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The rainbow lookout
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The final spring shower
sections.lesson: Carry the spray’s lift into the final dry landing. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.
